class.name: GDScript
class.brief_description: A script implemented in the GDScript programming language.
class.description: A script implemented in the GDScript programming language, saved with the [code].gd[/code] extension. The script extends the functionality of all objects that instantiate it. Calling [method new] creates a new instance of the script. [method Object.set_script] extends an existing object, if that object's class matches one of the script's base classes. If you are looking for GDScript's built-in functions, see [@GDScript] instead.

method.name: compile_source
method.description:
Compiles [param source] into a new script without modifying existing scripts or instances. Returns a dictionary containing [code]error[/code] (an [enum Error]), [code]script[/code] (a [GDScript] on success, otherwise [code]null[/code]), and [code]diagnostics[/code] (an [Array] of dictionaries). Each error diagnostic contains [code]stage[/code] ([code]parse[/code], [code]analyze[/code], [code]compile[/code], or [code]initialize[/code]), [code skip-lint]path[/code], [code]line[/code], [code]column[/code], and [code]message[/code]. Parser positions are one-based; unavailable positions may be zero or negative. Warnings are not returned. Initialization diagnostics include script errors reported on the calling thread; native code that fails without reporting a script error cannot be detected. Release builds omit some VM runtime checks and error reporting, so initialization diagnostics are not guaranteed in release exports. The optional [param path] supplies a source location for diagnostics and a directory for resolving relative dependencies. If empty, dependencies resolve from [code]res://[/code]. Compilation uses a unique virtual resource filename in that directory, so the returned script's path differs from [param path] and existing cached resources are preserved. The virtual source is not written to disk or retained in the script cache; static data remains alive only while callers hold the compiled script or its instances. Self-references by the supplied filename resolve through normal resource loading, not to this new script. On success the script can be instantiated with [method new], or explicitly attached to a compatible object with [method Object.set_script]. State migration is the caller's responsibility. Static initialization executes during compilation; source and its dependencies must be trusted. This method does not sandbox code or roll back external side effects of initialization. [codeblock] var result = GDScript.compile_source("extends RefCounted
func answer():
	return 42
") if result.error == OK: print(result.script.new().answer()) # Prints 42. else: print(result.diagnostics) [/codeblock]
